statement: The contributor API supports a distinct forward target through the same lease path and preserves its original draw buffers; scent decals invoke it without replacing deferred surface identities. Water surfaces, glass panes and waterfall sheet/pool slots resume the same contributor plane at their original draws; water metadata that cannot recover an exact chunk translation explicitly refuses attribution. Noncontributing fragments preserve prior contributor IDs; glass resolve retains pane identities and unavailable resolve resources refuse capture completion. Particle forward submissions remain uninstrumented. Both continuation planes retain earlier IDs and original color routing, and refuse mid-frame extent changes before resizing or leasing storage. Empty, sky, outside-field and negligible decal fragments discard before writing contributor IDs. Without forward storage or an instrumented current program, exact per-draw Forward records retain metadata with a :contributor_only label and completion remains false. Missing or aliased storage, nested attachment, invalid extents and mismatched contributor passes refuse coverage.
